choice.title: Driver and print queue
choice.description: The rastertobrother CUPS filter, the PPD and the brscan scanner client. Adds a print queue for the DCP-T420W if one is found on the network.

choice.title: Share the printer with iPhone and iPad — opens it to your local network
choice.description: OFF BY DEFAULT — ticking this opens your printer to everyone on your local network, with no password. Tick it on a network you trust, such as home. Do not tick it on a laptop that joins cafe, hotel or shared office Wi-Fi, because the setting follows the machine onto every network it later joins. The DCP-T420W is Mopria rather than AirPrint, so an iPhone cannot reach it any other way: this makes the Mac print on the phone's behalf, and the Mac has to stay awake. Nothing is exposed to the internet. Reversible at any time with: sudo launchctl bootout system/com.hwisu.dcp-t420w.airprint and sudo cupsctl --no-share-printers
